title: Bakery client (NDA)
oneLine: A demand forecasting model for a bakery, trained on 1.1M sales records. It predicts daily pastry demand per store and item three days ahead from lag, holiday and weather features.

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.answer: In walk-forward backtests it cut forecast error (WAPE) from 33.8% for a last-week baseline to 25.1%.
